overview.description: The Schwab International Equity ETF (SCHF) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the FTSE All-World Developed x US index. The fund tracks the FTSE Developed ex-US Index, a market cap-weighted index that consists of large- and mid-cap stocks in developed markets. SCHF was launched on Nov 3, 2009 and is issued by Charles Schwab.
